Full program accessibility involves a new passenger elevator addition serving all floors - cellar-4 fl and EMR room. Provide new fire rescue area rooms, accessible toilets, modify some classrooms and ADA spaces in Public Assemblies
Regrading and pavement replacement for new elevator addition

New elevator shaft in building. Design of new floor shafts. Detail concrete platform for wheel chairs in auditorium. New wheelchair lifts structure in auditorium and gym. Design of lintels for new and enlarged openings.

Remove select exhaust fans, ductwork, sire distribution and provide new. Remove select convectors, steam piping and accessories and provide new. Provide new air supply and return fans at proposed fire rescue rooms with fire dampers

Install new elevator sump pump for new elevator. Remove & cap existing plumbing fixtures & piping. Provide new plumbing fixtures and reconnect all new associates plumbing piping to existing piping. Upgrade water risers and sanitary stacks
Regrading and pavement replacement for new elevator addition
Roof and window replacement. Raising low parapets. Exterior masonry repointing work, repair damaged masonry and corner face brick replacement a specific locations.
Replace roof drains and relocate roof drains and vent pipes.
Relocate existing (4) wall mounted air cooled condensing units to mounting on roof on equipment curbs and extend all piping, wiring and controls.
